data.title: 椎叶紬 · 桌上的约定
data.description: 大家商量完事情先离开了，紬留下来把写好的约定压在桌角。她又添了一笔，免得有人忘记集合时间。
data.action: 她又添了一笔，免得有人忘记集合时间
data.promptProse: At a table in the club room, Tsumugi writes one last reminder on a page before leaving it for her friends.
data.animaCaption: Leaning over the club room table with a pencil poised in hand, she jots one last meeting reminder onto a sheet of paper while steadying the page with her other hand. Soft window daylight brightens the quiet tabletop.
